steps.caption: Open Scores from the More menu: who to focus on first.
Counters: companies scored, high-priority companies and leads, matches, contacts ranked…
'Waiting to recalculate' and 'Not enough data' show what is still pending.
'Score everything now' recalculates all scores at once — normally they update on their own.
Tabs: Companies, Leads, Contacts, Requirements, Property matches, Opportunities, Relationships.
Filter by priority and confidence, and sort — highest, lowest, recent, most complete.
More filters: industry, place, lease expiry, owner, score range, completeness.
Each row: rank, recommended action, the score bar, confidence, % known, score and priority.
Top: the score, priority, confidence and completeness. 'Open record' goes to the company; 'Recalculate' re-scores now.
Recommended next step: what the score suggests you do.
AI summary: a plain-English read of the score. It explains, it never changes the score.
How the score is built: points per factor, out of its maximum.
Open a factor to see the evidence behind it — linked signals and sources with dates.
A factor with no data shows 'Unknown' — left out, not scored as zero.
Missing information: what would make the score more certain. Key risks: what could undermine it.
Change priority: overrule the band with a reason (next video).
Is this score right? Send feedback — too high, too low, wrong company… — to tune the rules.
The same scores appear on the company page under its Scores tab.
